newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa futures weaker, shrug off Stals' comments.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa futures weaker, shrug off Stals' comments.

text.p: 0728 GMT - South African share futures start weaker as enthusiasm over hopes for an early cut in interest rates dims after poor credit extension data earlier this week. No positive cue from comments from Reserve Bank Governor Chris Stals' earlier that he hopeful of relaxation in monetary policy before year end.
* Golds tame on a lacklustre bullion price. Industrial futures see some profit-taking.
* Dealers expect cash market to open lower amid a lack of direction and a later-rather-than-sooner monetary policy easing.
* Overall volumes thin as the September gold contract last at 685/90 from 694 settlement, industrial contract at 8,628/37 from 8,640 and the all-share contract at 6,700/10 from 6,718.
